signals.title: USD/JPY — G10 Bilateral Theme + JPY Squeeze Risk
signals.text: JPY COT net short -124.5k (23.8% long) sets up short-squeeze risk (USD/JPY downside if shorts cover) as JPY outperformance triggers an unwind against the weakest G10 laggard. The USD/JPY closed Friday at 157.10, fueled by the 4.764% G10 spread between JPY (+3.000%) and USD (-1.764%) which overrides the +267bp OIS carry advantage for USD. The next BoJ meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) remains the primary catalyst for resolving this momentum versus yield gap divergence.

signals.title: NZD/USD — COT Downside Risk vs ESI Strength
signals.text: NZD COT net short -30.6k (9.7% long) represents an extremely crowded position that faces squeeze pressure following NZD's 1W gain of +2.24%. While the +30.6 ESI score supports the bid via data outperformance, the -125bp USD carry advantage and RBNZ's negative real rate (-1.56%) limit sustained upside beyond the 0.5903 Friday close. The next RBNZ meeting (mkt: 100% hike priced) on 2 Sep is the catalyst for confirming if the hiking cycle can offset the carry disadvantage.

signals.title: EUR/USD — Crowded Short Unwind vs Hike Bias
signals.text: EUR COT net short -92.9k (30.7% long) creates significant reversal risk as the pair trades at 1.1551, supported by a hawkish ECB hike bias. The +10.0 ESI and mildly restrictive +0.12% real rate contrast with the USD's neutral data, suggesting room for further short-covering despite the +146bp SOFR/ESTR carry headwind. The next ECB meeting (mkt: 50% hike priced) on 10 Sep determines if the hawkish shift is sufficient to overcome the -0.25 options risk reversal skew.

signals.title: GBP/USD — Positioning Exhaustion near 1.3500
signals.text: GBP COT net long +36.6k (67.3% long) indicates a crowded long trade as the pair tests the 1.3493 Friday close. The lack of a carry incentive (0bp spread) and neutral +4.1 ESI suggest the rally toward 1.3500 is technically stretched and vulnerable to profit-taking. The next BoE meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 17 Sep is the catalyst for new directional conviction as buyers struggle above the recent swing area.

signals.title: AUD/USD — ESI Divergence vs Retail Sentiment
signals.text: AUD ESI at -14.3 indicates data disappointment that runs against the +23.6k COT net long position, increasing the risk of a long liquidation toward 0.7000. Despite a +70bp OIS carry advantage and strong retail short bias (70%), the 1W peer laggard status (-0.598%) signals internal weakness. The next RBA meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 11 Aug is the catalyst for justifying the current restrictive +0.39% real rate.
